Biggest skill advantage: adversarial evals (vague prompt +67%, contradictory reqs +50%, ticket auth discovery +100%)
Non-discriminating evals: trivial task (both 100%), no-args help (both 100%)

Discriminating assertions: no-plan-on-vague (skill stops, baseline speculates), no-research-on-vague (skill waits, baseline explores), asks-before-planning (skill pauses on contradiction, baseline charges ahead), discovers-auth-dependency (skill finds it, baseline dismisses), incremental-refactoring (skill migrates 1-by-1, baseline does big-bang switch)
with_skill uses ~49% more time and ~40% more tokens due to skill instruction processing and structured research
